```rust
//| id: generic-charts
//| inputs:
//|   fixture: { type: text, label: Fixture, value: '{"kind":"line","series":[]}' }
//|   metadata: { type: text, label: Metadata, value: '{"id":"chart-id","title":"Artifact title","caption":"Caption"}' }
//| tests:
//|   - case: default
//|     expect: [{ artifact: chart-id, path: /spec/kind, equals: line }]
let spec: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&fixture).map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
let metadata: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&metadata).map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
emit_chart!(&spec);
emit_chart!(&spec, metadata = metadata);
```

```rust
//| id: colliding-locals
fn author_label() -> &'static str { "author value" }
macro_rules! author_number { () => { 42 }; }
let __stdout = author_label();
let __outputs = author_number!();
for value in [__outputs] {
    println!("{__stdout}:{value}");
}
println!();
emit_json!(&serde_json::json!({ "label": __stdout, "number": __outputs }));
Ok::<_, String>(123)
```

//| id: inputs-and-question-mark

    if fail { Err("question mark failure".to_owned()) } else { Ok(42) }
}
let __stdout = label;
let __outputs = author_number(fail)?;
println!("{__stdout}:{__outputs}");
emit_text!(format!("{__stdout}:{__outputs}"));

```rust
//| id: declared-tests
//| inputs:
//|   n: { type: number, value: 1 }
//|   fail: { type: checkbox, value: false }
//|   spin: { type: checkbox, value: false }
//| cases:
//|   - { id: named, label: Named, inputs: { n: 2 } }
//|   - { id: failure, label: Failure, inputs: { fail: true } }
//|   - { id: timeout, label: Timeout, inputs: { spin: true } }
//| tests:
//|   - case: default
//|     expect:
//|       - { path: /outputs/0/value/n, equals: 1 }
//|       - { path: /outputs/0/value/residual, approx: { value: 0, atol: 1.0e-8 } }
//|   - case: named
//|     expect:
//|       - { path: /outputs/0/value/n, range: { min: 2, max: 2 } }
//|       - { path: /outputs/0/value/status, equals: iteration-limit }
//|   - case: failure
//|     expect: [{ error: requested failure }]
//| timeoutMs: 1000
if spin { loop { std::hint::spin_loop(); } }
if fail { return Err("requested failure".to_owned()); }
emit_json!(&serde_json::json!({ "n": n, "status": "iteration-limit", "residual": 1.0e-10 }));
```

```rust
//| id: isolated-state
//| cases:
//|   - { id: second, label: Second, inputs: {} }
//| tests:
//|   - { case: default, expect: [{ path: /outputs/0/value, equals: 1 }] }
//|   - { case: second, expect: [{ path: /outputs/0/value, equals: 1 }] }
std::thread_local! { static COUNTER: std::cell::Cell<i32> = const { std::cell::Cell::new(0) }; }
let count = COUNTER.with(|counter| { counter.set(counter.get() + 1); counter.get() });
emit_json!(&count);
```

```rust
//| id: internal-output-limits
//| tests:
//|   - case: default
//|     expect:
//|       - { path: /outputs/0/value/exact_bytes, equals: 1048576 }
//|       - { path: /outputs/0/value/exact_truncated, equals: false }
//|       - { path: /outputs/0/value/oversized_bounded, equals: true }
//|       - { path: /outputs/0/value/oversized_truncated, equals: true }
//|       - { path: /outputs/0/value/error_bounded, equals: true }
use std::fmt::Write as _;
let mut exact = BoundedText::new();
write!(&mut exact, "{}", "x".repeat(1048576)).map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
let mut oversized = BoundedText::new();
write!(&mut oversized, "{}", "語".repeat(1048576)).map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
let error = bounded_error_message(&"語".repeat(8193));
emit_json!(&serde_json::json!({
    "exact_bytes": exact.content.len(), "exact_truncated": exact.truncated,
    "oversized_bounded": oversized.content.len() <= 1048576,
    "oversized_truncated": oversized.truncated,
    "error_bounded": error.len() <= 16384,
}));
```
